description: Aluminium lamp poles (single, double and triple head) imported together with LED street lights.
source_ref: Public Notice 20/2026, ref C-104/KAPE/DC/PCT/2018 (GD KAPE-HC-132413 of 25-01-2018)
notes: Poles are parts of lighting fittings of heading 94.05 even when imported separately; declared 7604.2910.
reason: Printed code 9405.4090 is not a line in the FY2025-26 or FY2026-27 tariff (HS 2022 restructured 94.05.4 into 9405.41/42/49 lines); GD is from 2018. The heading 9405 is still valid.

description: 'Predust and Batter' coating mixes made of wheat flour with starch, gluten, baking powder, salt and spices.
notes: Committee: flour-based food preparation of heading 19.01, not flour of 11.01.
reason: Printed code 1901.1920 is not a line in either tariff (heading 1901 has 1901.1000, 1901.2000, 1901.9000 only); likely a typo or an older national line. Heading 1901 is valid.

description: Outdoor unit of a tropical multi-split (MPS) inverter air conditioner, 5 tonnes and above, imported for 4 models.
notes: Committee: multi-MPS systems, even with reversible heat pumps, go to the tropical MPS line (GIR 1 and 3(a)); Collectorate had 8415.8100, consultant 8415.1039.
reason: Printed 8415.1030 is a 7-digit national sub-heading (tropical MPS multi system unit, 5 tonnes and above), not an 8-digit line. The 8-digit lines are 8415.1031 (CKD/SKD) and 8415.1039 (other); the notice does not say which.

description: Agricultural spraying drone (hexacopter, DJI Agras T-16 type) imported for anti-locust work.
notes: Committee: aircraft not exceeding 2,000 kg, heading 88.02; importer had claimed 8424.2010 (spraying appliances).
reason: Code string exists in the tariff, but the ruling concerns goods imported under the older nomenclature (about 2020). In HS 2022 (our two tariffs) unmanned aircraft have their own heading 88.06, so 8802.2000 is probably no longer the right answer today. Not safe as ground truth.

description: Analog/HDCVI CCTV cameras without accessories, up to 2.0 megapixel.
notes: Valuation ruling: the PCT is printed in the ruling's table and the ruling says HS codes are for illustrative purposes, so this is weaker evidence than a classification ruling. Proposed WeBOC code 8525.8010.1000.
reason: Printed code 8525.8010 is not a line in the FY2025-26 or FY2026-27 tariff; the CCTV camera line there is 8525.8910. The valuation ruling uses an outdated code and says codes are illustrative.
